intent: Dark blue architectural ambience, deep blue backing, restrained blue tank-edge spill and neutral-cool fish lighting. Native artwork and saved finishes remain unchanged.
limitations: Shaded fish, substrate and architecture respond to lighting; unshaded source-art props retain their authored colors.
Each tank uses two bounded spots (one casts shadows) and one short-range blue omni without shadows; no additional shadow map for spill.
Blue spill and backing are art-directed approximations, not simulated water transmission, glass refraction or realtime global illumination.
No global blue screen filter; source textures, native pixel sampling and saved material choices are retained.
